about: Barbarian Village (Edgeville piece step 5): Peksa, Tassie Slipcast, Hunding, Atlas, Checkal, Litara and Sigurd. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, 2026), checked against the 241 cache's types and the OSRS Wiki's Barbarian Village page. Checkal and Litara are multi-NPCs, spawned as the type the map holds. Every wander range is guessed until recorded. The barbarians, Gunthor the brave and the unicorns are step 7's.
